_doc: Heaven, the modern city in its shield (the user's list of 2026-11-08b, docs/improvements9.txt: 'a modern city that is surrounded by a shimmering shield. it is characterized by modern skyscrapers, office buildings, modern shops, modern streets, modern vehicles navigating the streets. the dungeon is a mechanized fortress ... the outside and entrance of the dungeon is a foreboding research facility called Kratos Aurorim Research, LLC'). Its people and quests, read by 908 (the townsfolk and quests of the town 'Heaven'; the bodies are the dystopian city's and the old gangsters' NPC packs, modern clothes, with their own clips). Its quests count the fortress's own counters (heaven:enter, :tier, :kills, :boss).

townsfolk.name: HV_Director
townsfolk.title: Director Cassia Vael
lines: Heaven has stood behind its shield for forty years. Nothing gets in. Lately, I wonder what the shield keeps in.
Kratos Aurorim built half this city. Their facility hasn't let a visitor past the lobby in a decade.
If you carry the keycard from Kethrys Spire, the security door will read it. I can't stop you. I'd rather you went in than anyone else.
topics: What is Kratos Aurorim?|A research company. Defence contracts, they said. Then the deliveries stopped coming out, and the guards stopped going home.
What is under the facility?|A fortress, by the power draw. Machines, armed men, whatever they were building. The scans go dark three floors down.

townsfolk.name: HV_Scientist
townsfolk.title: Dr. Imre Solace
lines: I worked in Lab Four until they revoked my clearance. I still dream about the hum.
Whatever they built down there learns. That was the point.

townsfolk.name: HV_Captain
townsfolk.title: Security Chief Dana Roarke
lines: My officers patrol every street but one: Kratos has its own guards.
Their defenders carry rifles. Real ones. Keep your head down in there.

townsfolk.name: HV_Chaplain
townsfolk.title: Chaplain Ruth Okonkwo
lines: Even in Heaven, people need somewhere quiet.
Sit a while. The city never stops humming.

townsfolk.name: HV_Armorer
townsfolk.title: Teo Brask, armorer
lines: Old blades, new alloys. I can mend anything you drag in here.
The things under Kratos wear plating. Bring me a piece if you find one.

townsfolk.name: HV_Merchant
townsfolk.title: Lydia Marsh
lines: Imported, everything. The shield lets the trucks through on schedule.
Cash or credit. Mostly cash, these days.

townsfolk.name: HV_Doctor
townsfolk.title: Dr. Abel Nwosu
lines: Sit down before you fall down.
Gunshot, burn or something worse? I've seen all three this month.

townsfolk.name: HV_Clerk
townsfolk.title: Morris Haig
lines: Locker forty-two is yours for as long as you pay for it.
Sign here. And here. And here.

townsfolk.name: HV_Bartender
townsfolk.title: Nina Sato
lines: First drink's on the house if you've been under Kratos and come back.
Nobody's collected on that offer yet.

townsfolk.name: HV_Preacher
townsfolk.title: a street preacher
lines: The shield is a wall! Who are they protecting? Ask yourselves!
They built a heaven and locked the angels underneath!

townsfolk.name: HV_Office1
townsfolk.title: an office worker
lines: Quarterly numbers, quarterly numbers.
Don't stand by the window. Kratos drones watch the towers.

townsfolk.name: HV_Office2
townsfolk.title: an office worker
lines: My badge used to open the facility's lobby. Not anymore.
Coffee's terrible. The view is good.

townsfolk.name: HV_ShopClerk
townsfolk.title: a shop clerk
lines: Can I help you find anything?
We close at the shield's dimming.

townsfolk.name: HV_Security1
townsfolk.title: a Kratos security guard
lines: Restricted facility. Keep moving.
No keycard, no entry. No exceptions.

townsfolk.name: HV_Officer
townsfolk.title: a city officer
lines: Stay on the pavement. The cars don't stop for long.
Move along, citizen.

townsfolk.name: HV_Patrol
townsfolk.title: a patrol officer
lines: Quiet night. Too quiet, under the shield.
Report anything coming out of the facility.

townsfolk.name: HV_Kid1
townsfolk.title: Milo
lines: Have you been outside the shield? What's it like?
My dad says the sky out there isn't blue.

townsfolk.name: HV_Kid2
townsfolk.title: Ava
lines: I can see the shield shimmer if I squint.
Race you to the fountain!

townsfolk.name: HV_Mourner
townsfolk.title: Widow Ellery
lines: He went to work at Kratos. They sent back his badge.
Forty years of safety, and it still finds us.

townsfolk.name: HV_Busker
townsfolk.title: Jax the Busker
lines: A coin for a song? A song for a coin? Both, why not!
I sing about the shield. Nobody likes that one.

townsfolk.name: HV_Citizen1
townsfolk.title: a citizen
lines: Busy day.
Watch where you're walking.

townsfolk.name: HV_Citizen2
townsfolk.title: a citizen
lines: You're not from Heaven, are you?
The trains stopped running years ago. Everyone drives.

townsfolk.name: HV_Citizen3
townsfolk.title: a citizen
lines: Nice weather. It's always nice weather.
Don't look at the facility too long. People notice.

quests.title: Past the Lobby
quests.offer: Take the Kratos Keycard to the security door at the back of the facility. Go through, and come back to tell me what's below.
quests.done: So there is a below. Tell no one else yet.
quests.hint: The security door is at the far wall of the facility's laboratory hall.

quests.title: Deeper Clearance
quests.offer: Reach the fortress's second tier. I need to know how far down it goes.
quests.done: Two floors of guns and machines. And more under that.

quests.title: The Core
quests.offer: Reach the fourth tier. Whatever Kratos is building, it is there.
quests.done: Then it's real. Heaven owes you more than gold.

quests.title: Security Sweep
quests.offer: Kratos's defenders have started coming up the service shafts. Put down thirty of them.
quests.done: Thirty. My officers can breathe again.

quests.title: The Fortress Commander
quests.offer: Somebody down there gives the orders. Find whoever commands a tier and end them.
quests.done: Leaderless machines are still machines. But slower.

quests.title: Former Staff
quests.offer: Talk to one of the office workers. Some of them held Kratos badges once.
quests.done: Badges that no longer open anything. Of course.

quests.title: Contract: Rogue Defenders
quests.offer: City contract: twelve Kratos defenders, confirmed.
